title: Sum of a list
reference_explanation: Makes a list of three numbers and prints their total, which is 6.

title: Even or odd
reference_explanation: Checks whether n divides by 2 with no remainder. If it does, it prints even, otherwise odd. For 7 it prints odd.

title: Count 1 to 5
reference_explanation: Repeats the print step once for each number from 1 to 5, so it prints 1 2 3 4 5 on separate lines.

title: Add function
reference_explanation: Defines a function called add that gives back the sum of two numbers, then calls it with 2 and 3 and prints 5.

title: Reverse a string
reference_explanation: Stores the word hello and prints it backwards as olleh. The [::-1] part means read the text from the end to the start.

title: Factorial
reference_explanation: A function that calls itself with a smaller number each time until it reaches 0, multiplying as it goes. fact(5) is 5x4x3x2x1, so it prints 120.
